expShare.note: Red Gyarados at Lake of Rage (T29) gives the Red Scale (scr_seq_0938_T29.s: FLAG_GOT_RED_SCALE); Mr. Pokemon's house on Route 30 trades it for the Exp. Share (scr_seq_0229_R30R0201.s: ITEM_EXP__SHARE). Lake of Rage opens at route stage 6, before Petrel (Mahogany Hideout). This is the only Exp. Share source in the scripts.
expShare.split: src/battle/battle_command.c: with a holder, half of the EXP is split among participants and half among holders; a holder that also fought gets both shares.
